verses.pali: “Chayime, bhikkhave, dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: “These six things lead to the decline of a mendicant trainee.

verses.pali: Kammārāmatā, bhassārāmatā, niddārāmatā, saṅgaṇikārāmatā, indriyesu aguttadvāratā, bhojane amattaññutā—
verses.english: They relish work, talk, sleep, and company. They don’t guard the sense doors, and they eat too much.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, cha dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: These six things lead to the decline of a mendicant trainee.

verses.pali: Chayime, bhikkhave, dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: These six things don’t lead to the decline of a mendicant trainee.

verses.pali: Na kammārāmatā, na bhassārāmatā, na niddārāmatā, na saṅgaṇikārāmatā, indriyesu guttadvāratā, bhojane mattaññutā—
verses.english: They don’t relish work, talk, sleep, and company. They guard the sense doors, and they don’t eat too much.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, cha dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṁvattantī”ti.
verses.english: These six things don’t lead to the decline of a mendicant trainee.”
